## 2. Root Cause Diagnostic: Why Screaming Frog Found Only a Handful of URLs

In the previous crawl, Screaming Frog returned only **4 total URLs** (`https://www.sanocea.com/`, 2 JS/CSS assets, and `book.sanocea.com/embed.js`), while the repository contains multiple standalone HTML pages (`demo.html`, `console.html`, `whatsapp-demo.html`, and `/solutions/marketplace-reconciliation/index.html`).

Our URL Discovery Engine (`urlDiscovery.ts` & `crawler.ts`) established the exact technical reason:

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        WHY LEGACY HTTP CRAWLERS STOPPED AT PAGE 1                      │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  1. No XML Sitemap declared in robots.txt or standard root (/sitemap.xml).
  2. Single-Page Application (SPA) architecture:
     - The homepage renders `<div id="root"></div>` with 0 initial child elements.
     - Static HTML contains ZERO `<a href="/...">` tags pointing to internal pages.
     - Navigation items ("Diagnostic", "Demo", "WhatsApp Ops") are rendered purely via
       client-side React DOM hydration and JavaScript event listeners (gtag / state switches).
  3. Consequently, a traditional HTTP crawler (non-JS) fetches index.html, extracts 0
     internal HTML hyperlinks, and terminates immediately!
```

### SANOCEA URL Discovery Solution Implemented:
* **Recursive XML Sitemap Parser:** Ingests sitemaps and nested sitemap indexes even if unlinked in HTML.
* **Dual-Engine JS Escalation Trigger (`evaluateJsEscalationNeed`):** Automatically flags when an HTML payload has an empty `#root` container, missing SSR `<h1>`, and 0 static `<a>` links, escalating the page to headless Playwright execution to extract post-hydration links.
* **Canonical & JS-Data Discovery:** Extracts URLs embedded in `data-url`, `data-href`, and canonical tags.
* **Cross-Subdomain Scope Configuration:** Allows traversing `book.sanocea.com` and `sanocea.com` under unified registered domain rules.

## 4. Strict GEO & AI Readiness Handling

Per our core architectural directives, **`/llms.txt` absence and AI crawler directives are NOT treated as SEO errors**:
* **Evidence Class:** `[GEO] GEO Readiness`
* **Severity:** `INFO`
* **Remediation Status:** `INFORMATIONAL`
* **Rationale:** Traditional search engines (Google, Bing) do not require `/llms.txt`. Marking its absence as an "SEO Error" creates false alarms and erodes prospect credibility. Instead, the engine notes:
  > *"Neutral for traditional search ranking. Deploying `/llms.txt` is an emerging GEO strategy to ensure LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) ingest clean domain summaries rather than unparsed client-side JavaScript."*

## 5. Controlled Closed-Loop Proof: Detection to Independent Verification

We proved the complete 12-step closed-loop operating model on a controlled fixture before touching any production files:

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        CLOSED-LOOP OPERATIONAL VERIFICATION FLOW                       │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

 [1. Detect]
   Title: "SANOCEA™ | AI-Assisted Ecommerce Operations & Marketplace Exception Automation"
   Calculated Width: 618px (Exceeds 561px SERP limit)
   Severity: HIGH · Status: ACTION_REQUIRED

        │
        ▼
 [2. Human Approval Stage]
   Recommended Remediation: "SANOCEA™ | AI-Assisted Ecommerce Operations" (54 chars / 472px)
   Status Transition: ACTION_REQUIRED ➔ APPROVED

        │
        ▼
 [3. Remediation Execution]
   ClosedLoopRemediator.applyRemediation(initialHtml, finding, approvedTitle)
   DOM Updated: <title> tag replaced with approved concise title.

        │
        ▼
 [4. Independent Recrawl & Audit]
   Crawler re-fetches and parses the modified DOM.
   TechnicalSeoObserver re-evaluates calculateTitlePixelWidth(newTitle).
   Result: 472px <= 561px limit.

        │
        ▼
 [5. Verification Confirmation]
   isResolved: TRUE
   findingAfter: NULL (0 new title findings emitted)
   afterEvidence: "SANOCEA™ | AI-Assisted Ecommerce Operations"
   Status Transition: APPROVED ➔ VERIFIED
```

* [`src/core/urlDiscovery.ts`](file:///opt/sanocea/repo/packages/seo-stack/src/core/urlDiscovery.ts): Sitemap XML recursion, robots.txt AI bots, link normalization, and subdomain scoping.

* [`src/observers/technicalSeoObserver.ts`](file:///opt/sanocea/repo/packages/seo-stack/src/observers/technicalSeoObserver.ts): Titles, meta descriptions, SSR H1, security headers, internal links.
* [`src/observers/indexabilityObserver.ts`](file:///opt/sanocea/repo/packages/seo-stack/src/observers/indexabilityObserver.ts): Canonical integrity, loops, noindex/x-robots directives.
* [`src/observers/ecommerceObserver.ts`](file:///opt/sanocea/repo/packages/seo-stack/src/observers/ecommerceObserver.ts): Shopify collection dilution, `InStock` structured data conflicts on OOS items, GTIN validation.
* [`src/observers/geoObserver.ts`](file:///opt/sanocea/repo/packages/seo-stack/src/observers/geoObserver.ts): `/llms.txt` and AI bot directive auditing.
* [`src/pipeline/auditPipeline.ts`](file:///opt/sanocea/repo/packages/seo-stack/src/pipeline/auditPipeline.ts): End-to-end pipeline and `ClosedLoopRemediator`.
* [`src/fixtures/sanoceaFixtures.ts`](file:///opt/sanocea/repo/packages/seo-stack/src/fixtures/sanoceaFixtures.ts): Sanocea baseline and Shopify test fixtures.
* [`src/cli.ts`](file:///opt/sanocea/repo/packages/seo-stack/src/cli.ts): Command-line audit generator.
* [`tests/seoStack.test.ts`](file:///opt/sanocea/repo/packages/seo-stack/tests/seoStack.test.ts): 7 automated verification tests (**all passing**).
